**Preserve the loader identity in relationship snapshots.**

When a legacy card has no stored `:uuid`, `relationship-snapshot` omits its loader-derived identity. `relationships/inspect-graph` then reports `:malformed-uuid`, and `relationships/admit-update` cannot match the card for edits. The same snapshot reaches predecessor admission during status transitions, so the card can be refused there as well.

Use the loader's resolved identity for cards without a stored `:uuid`, while preserving the stored frontmatter values.
